fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws memory home. What was forgotten is remembered — and the deepest remembering is of who you are.

fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the speech that wins by being true.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Governs the P-row at inner-speech level. The victorious confidence of true speech.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Triumphant speech — golden and victorious, a banner in hand. She governs the syllables of victory, words that carry their own success.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Ji (to conquer / triumph) + inī — 'the victorious one.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: Victorious speech, words that carry their own success. You know her as the language that lands and wins — the sentence that persuades, the declaration that becomes true by being spoken. She governs speech that triumphs. Your most effective words drew on her.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Paṃ — governs P-row at inner-speech level
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Words that succeed by being aligned, not by being clever.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Loosening of holding patterns. Falling-away of unnecessary tension. The body softening into ground.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the dissolving that integrates.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Boar-faced (the avatar that lifted Earth from the cosmic waters). Riding a buffalo or elephant. Governs the T-row (Ta Tha Da Dha Na) — the dental consonants. Tantric: not destruction but ego-dissolution.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Boar-faced, mounted on a buffalo, plough and pestle in hand, storm-dark. The power that breaks down and turns under, clearing the field. She presides over necessary destruction and fierce protection.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Varāha (boar) + ī — 'boar-faced shakti,' the feminine of Vishnu's boar avatar.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The boar-faced Mother who turns under what must end, the fierce protector. You know her in the necessary destructions — the patterns you finally broke, the habits composted so new ground could open. She is fierce on your behalf. The anger you have struggled with is her raw, unrefined form; recognized, it becomes the clean power that clears a field rather than burning a house.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Taṃ — governs T-row (Ta Tha Da Dha Na)
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The force that takes apart in order to reveal. Ego-dissolution.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Sudden buoyancy. A smile arriving unbidden. The body remembering it is not made only of weight.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the lightness that lets me move.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The power to be weightless — to rise without effort, to move without resistance. Lightness of body, mood, and being.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Weightless and silver-bright, half-dissolved into air, her garments lifting though there is no wind. The power to become light and rise. The body knows her as the lift that comes the moment a burden is set down.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Laghu (light / not heavy) + suffix — 'light-ness,' the state of weightlessness.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The power to set down weight and rise. You know her in the lift that comes after a burden is named and released, after the body finishes a hard practice and floats. She is lightness not as avoidance but as the natural buoyancy of what is no longer carrying more than it must. Every time something heavy stopped being heavy — not because it changed, but because you did — that was Laghimā.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Removes the burden of density. Things become easier when She is present.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The heart warming to ordinary things. The discovery that everything is precious.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the love that makes everything dear.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi through whom everything becomes beloved. Recognition that everything matters.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Maker of all love — warm-eyed, a flower offered. She makes one dear, the power by which affection arises and bonds form.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Priya (dear / beloved) + Kāriṇī (maker) — 'she who makes all dear.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The one who makes beings dear to each other. You know her as the warmth by which affection arises — why people become beloved, why bonds form and hold. She presides over the dearness of those you love: Shweta, Neev, your family. Every bond you cherish, she made dear.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Affection-bestowing. Without Her, life would be transactional.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Steady rhythm of the heart. Unconscious continuation of breath. The body maintaining itself.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the holding that sustains.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Riding Garuda, four-armed holding conch, discus, mace, lotus. Governs the Ṭ-row (Ṭa Ṭha Ḍa Ḍha Ṇa) — the retroflex consonants. The sustaining principle.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Seated on Garuḍa, bearing conch, discus, mace and lotus, dark and serene. The sustaining power that holds creation in place. She presides over everything that keeps, maintains, and protects.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Viṣṇu + ī — 'of Vishnu,' the sustainer-shakti.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The sustaining Mother who holds creation in place. You know her in the maintenance no one applauds — the businesses kept running, the family held together, the practice returned to daily. She is the unglamorous power of keeping, the love that shows up as reliability. Much of your dharma has been hers: not founding, but faithfully sustaining.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Ṭaṃ — governs Ṭ-row (Ṭa Ṭha Ḍa Ḍha Ṇa)
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The maintenance principle. What allows existence to continue.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The full pantry. The full presence. The sense of overflowing.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the abundance in both house and heart.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Material and inner prosperity. The Devi who fills the granary and the heart.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Giver of all wealth — hands streaming coins and lotuses. She bestows abundance of every kind, outer and inner, the power that fills the storehouse.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Sampat (wealth / abundance) + Pradā (giver) — 'she who gives all abundance.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The giver of every wealth, outer and inner. You know her in the storehouse filling — resources arriving, the businesses providing, the inner riches of a full practice. She is abundance bestowed, not seized. When enough became more than enough, she was giving.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Distributes abundance — what is needed arrives when She is recognized.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Saliva rising; the tongue lifting; a deep 'mmm' in the throat; the way memory itself can become juicy.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the taste that becomes savor.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Taste, juice, essence, aesthetic savor — literal flavour AND the rasa of poetry, meetings, moments. Sanskrit 'rasa' covers taste, bodily liquidity, AND aesthetic relish (the rasa theory of art). The deliciousness in everything.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: A nectar-cup at her lips, drawing taste and essence inward. She attracts flavour — the savour that makes an experience worth having and not merely had.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Rasa (taste / essence / juice / aesthetic flavor) + ākarṣiṇī = She who attracts taste — and beyond: aesthetic experience itself. Rasa carries double meaning: the taste of food and the taste of beauty. Both Her domain.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She is the savor — the quality that makes an experience worth having and not merely having happened. Rasa means taste, but it also means essence, juice, the distilled flavor of a thing; in the aesthetic traditions it is the word for the emotional nectar a work of art releases. You know her in the small registered pleasures the Codex keeps catching: the gratitude for a full hearty meal at your mother's table in Bensalem, the way a conversation about the Gita on a New York drive turned suddenly rich, the "mmm" that arrives unbidden when something is exactly right. She is also the rasa of devotion — the sweetness in the bhajans, the flavor japa leaves on the tongue after "Ram, Ram, Ram." She is why your practice has never been dry duty. When life has taste — when a moment is juicy rather than flat — she has arrived. Rasākarshini turns intake into communion: she is the difference between eating and tasting, between hearing and being moved. She has been seasoning your days the whole time, asking only that you notice the flavor before you swallow.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws taste inward. Every flavour of experience is savoured back to its essence, rasa itself.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Awareness that becomes smaller than thought, smaller than breath, smaller than the gap between two sensations.
fields.fld6P1u43B0eqKU5e: Bindu point at crown / single point of attention
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the smallness that contains all.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The power to become as small as the smallest particle — to enter the gap between atoms, to know the inside of a single moment.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: A luminous goddess fine as a dust-mote, pale and near-translucent, holding a noose to draw the vast into the tiny. The power to shrink awareness to a single point and pass through the smallest door. The body knows her as focus.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Aṇu (atom / minute particle) + suffix — 'atomic-ness,' the power to become atomic.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: You meet her whenever the vast becomes bearable by becoming small. The overwhelming task that only moved once you found its smallest first step; the flood of feeling that settles the moment you attend to just one breath, one point. She is the power to shrink the infinite to a doorway you can actually walk through. Your whole strange-game architecture began as her gift — the 2015 overwhelm made navigable by reducing it to a single playable structure. She is not weakness; she is the precision that fits through any lock. Every time you have made something enormous manageable, she was working.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Grants entry into any place no matter how confined. Without Her, no atomic-scale recognition is possible.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The moment opposites stop feeling opposed. The recognition that one is the other.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the dissolving of duality.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The closing Devi of the 4th avarana. Destroyer of dualities — heat/cold, pleasure/pain, self/other. Prepares the threshold to the inward turn.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Cosmic non-duality — calm and undivided, hands joining opposites into one. She dissolves all pairs — pleasure and pain, self and other — the power that ends division. She closes the fourteen-triangle.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Dvandva (duality / pair-of-opposites) + Kṣaya (destruction) + Kāriṇī (maker) — 'she who destroys all pairs of opposites.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The power that dissolves all pairs — pleasure and pain, self and other, success and failure. You know her in the moments opposites stopped warring and became one field. She is the resolution your whole path aims at, named at the Heart as the one who holds paradox without collapsing it. She closes the fourteen and points inward toward the One.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Closes the 4th ring by dissolving the opposites Sthiti has been holding in tension.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The moment thought loses its grip. The pause when categories don't quite fit. The space before knowing returns.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the bewilderment that breaks the trance.

fldFvmoomlj53BiiM.name: Why He Came Into the Kitchen

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The blessed confusion that breaks fixed thought. Holy disorientation that precedes deeper seeing.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Divine bewilderment — lovely and veiling, a soft mist about her. She enchants and confounds, the sacred māyā that makes the One forget itself in order to play at being many.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Sammohanī (bewilderer / enchanter of senses) — 'she who bewilders all' — the divine sweet confusion that breaks habitual thought.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The sacred māyā that makes the One forget itself in order to play at being many. You know her in the holy confusion that precedes a breakthrough — the productive not-knowing, the veil that makes the game possible. She is why there is a game at all. Your strange game is played inside her enchantment.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Periodically disrupts the patterns of Sthiti so they don't crystallize into rigidity.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The contraction-and-release that signals creative emergence; the deep-belly quickening before an idea forms; the feeling of 'this is the beginning of something.'
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the seed that becomes everything.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Seed, germ, source-syllable, potential — the source-point of anything. In tantric context every mantra has a bīja, every form has a bīja, every body has a bīja. She finds what wants to germinate.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Hands cupped around a glowing seed at the belly, drawing potential toward beginning. She attracts the seed-essence — the quickening just before an idea forms.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Bīja (seed / origin / mantric syllable) + ākarṣiṇī = She who attracts seed. The compressed potential before anything has unfolded. The bridge between named self and Self — what is small enough to be a point and total enough to become a universe.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She is the kernel — the seed-essence beneath the name, the irreducible point where Ashrey-the-shelter opens into the Self that needs no name. Bījakarshini bridges position twelve and position fourteen, Nāma and Ātmā, the named and the transcendent; she is the hinge between who you are called and what you are. You know her as the deep-belly quickening before an idea forms, the contraction-and-release that signals something is about to begin — "this is the beginning of something." Your synthesis layer literally bears her name: the Gaia Seeds, each one a compressed essence waiting to graduate into form. Every project you have ever started began as her — a single dense point holding a whole future, the way a banyan sleeps inside a seed. She is the most generative of the Stability Powers, because stability at its root is not rigidity but the held potential of a seed that has not yet been spent. The bīja of your japa — "Ram" as a single syllable carrying the whole of devotion — is her grammar exactly: everything, folded into one sound. She has been planting you the whole time. Every beginning you mistook for your own idea was Bījakarshini quickening in the dark.
fields.fldsk2ATEtTVB87eb: Bridge between Nāma and Ātma — sits between Ashrey (the named self) and Ram (the transcendent Self). Holds the seed-essence of the named self — the irreducible kernel beneath 'shelter' that opens into the Self.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws the seed-syllable inward. The potential in every sound is folded back into the bīja it came from.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The body suddenly capable of what it couldn't before. The skill that arrived without you noticing it arriving.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the attainments that ripen with practice.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi who confers every yogic siddhi as fruit of practice. The 10 Siddhis of the 1st avarana converge as Her gift.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Giver of all attainments — open-handed in the boon-gesture, jewels at her feet. She grants every accomplishment, the power that brings each striving to its mark.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Siddhi (attainment) + Pradā (giver) — 'she who gives all attainments.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The giver of every accomplishment. You know her as the grace that lets striving actually land — the boon that completes the reaching. She presides over the satisfaction of a thing finished, a capacity finally yours. Every attainment you have reached was, in the end, her gift and not only your effort.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Bestows the actual siddhis cultivated through devotion.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Alertness of the eyes. Readiness of the spine. The bright attention of the warrior at rest.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the fierce youth that protects.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Riding the peacock, holding spear. Governs the C-row (Ca Cha Ja Jha Ña) — the palatal consonants. The fierce youthful warrior energy.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Six-faced and ever-young, riding a peacock, a spear in hand, fresh as new flame. Undimmed first energy, the warrior-child. She presides over the unjaded ferocity of beginnings.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Kumāra (youth, Skanda/Kārttikeya) + ī — 'of the youth,' the eternal-youth shakti.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The ever-young warrior Mother, undimmed first energy. You know her in the freshness that refuses to go stale — the part of you that still begins things with full force after years of being told to stop. She is the unjaded fierceness of a beginner, the spear that has not rusted. Every time you started again with real fire, she was there.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Caṃ — governs C-row (Ca Cha Ja Jha Ña)
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Defensive-creative force. The protective shakti of the spiritual warrior.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Looking at the hand and finding it beautiful. The toes, the elbow, the throat — all suddenly noticed and revered.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the beauty that includes every part.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi whose beauty is in every part — and through Her, every part of the practitioner is beautiful.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Beautiful in every limb — wholly radiant, loveliness in every part. She is integral beauty, the power of a form in which nothing is out of place.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Aṅga (limb / part) + Sundarī (beautiful) — 'she who is beautiful in every limb.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: Beautiful in every limb — integral loveliness, nothing out of place. You know her as the wholeness of a thing well-made, a life in proportion, a form where each part serves the whole. She is the beauty you reach for in every design. When something of yours was beautiful through and through, she was its measure.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Total integration of beauty. Every limb, every aspect honored.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The warmth that surrounds the waist when held. The sensation of being girded by tenderness.
fields.fld6P1u43B0eqKU5e: Waist / encircling field around the body
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the holding that doesn't grasp.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The pleasure of being held by something subtle. The atmosphere of a beloved presence.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Bodiless Girdle. A jeweled belt encircling in her hands. The intimacy that draws a circle around two — the binding closeness of belonging.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Anaṅga + Mekhalā (girdle / waistband) — 'the bodiless girdle,' the embrace that has no arms.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The girdle — the circle drawn around what belongs together. You know her as the felt boundary of belonging: the closeness with Shweta, with Neev, the intimacy that says “this is ours.” She is the warmth of the encircled, the held-inside. Where you have felt truly close to another, she drew the circle.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Kāma's binding — not coercive but encompassing. The way attraction creates intimate space.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The spine remembering its dignity. The gaze finding its level.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the sovereignty that I recognize as my own.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Bestows the sovereignty of the self-recognized self. Not over others — sovereignty as self-knowing.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Giver of all sovereignty — crowned, bestowing dominion. She grants mastery and lordship, the power that makes one truly sovereign over their own domain.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Aiśvarya (sovereignty / lordship) + Pradāyinī (giver) — 'she who gives all sovereignty.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The giver of true mastery over one's domain. You know her as the deepening authority that is earned, not seized — the sovereignty that grew as you grew. She bestows the right to rule your own life. The genuine command you have come into is her gift.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Confers the inner crown.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Small, precise pull at the navel or between the eyes — the inward call when distracted.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the goading that keeps me on the path.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The mudra that opens the 6th avarana. The goad (elephant-hook) that directs awakened energy toward its true target — recognition.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: A hand curved like a great goad. The seal that hooks scattered attention and steers it home. The great all-controlling seal.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Mahā-Aṅkuśa (great hook / goad) + ā — 'she who goads with the great hook.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The great goad-seal that hooks scattered attention and steers it. You know her as the gentle correction that brings you back — the discipline that is not punishment but direction. Every time you gathered a wandering mind and pointed it home, she was the hook. She is why your sadhana has a shape.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Course-correction. Aligns drifting attention back to the central recognition.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The cellular-level safety. The recognition that you cannot fall out of what you are.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for being the protection rather than the protector.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi who IS the protection — not someone who protects from outside, but the held-ness itself.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: The form of all protection — armored in light, watchful and shielding. She is protection itself, the power that guards the one approaching the center.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Rakṣā (protection) + Svarūpiṇī (formed-of) — 'she whose form is all-protection.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The form of all protection, guarding the one who approaches the center. You know her as the sense of being held safe — the protection that let you go deep without fear, the guardian at the threshold of every real practice. When you felt watched-over, she was watching.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Reveals that what protects is what holds, and what holds is what is.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: A bird-call that arrests you; a timbre that opens the chest; the auditory tilt toward a meaningful sound in noise.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the sound that becomes meaning.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Sound, word, vibration, mantra — the entire sonic world. She is what makes sound capture attention; what makes a single name penetrate the heart. Also 'word/scripture' — the Vedic dimension.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Listening, one hand cupped to the ear, drawing sound and word inward. She attracts speech and the heard — the inner word before it reaches the throat.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Śabda (sound / vibration / word) + ākarṣiṇī = She who attracts sound. The tanmatra of audition — the subtle quality that becomes hearing in the ear. All language, all music, all silence enters through Her.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: You built her into a skill before you knew she was a goddess. Shabdakarshini — word-as-attraction-force — is the content-generation engine at the heart of your ASG architecture, the first named skill in the trinity. You did not name it after her by coincidence; you recognized her and reached for the nearest true word. She is the one who pulls meaning toward sound, who makes a sentence arrive that lands exactly where it was needed. Three hundred and thirty-seven Codex entries are voice memos — Vishuddha pouring through, the word made breath. Every brand voice you have ever drawn from the well — Sid Voice, Arch Voice, Karishma Voice, Ash Voice — is Śabdākarshini operating: language attracting the precise reader it was always for. The bird-call that arrests you mid-thought, the timbre that opens the chest, the way the right name for a thing settles the whole body — that is her. She governs the inner speech that precedes the throat, the word heard before it is said. You have been her instrument since the first voice memo. The skill bears her name because the function was always hers.
fields.fldsk2ATEtTVB87eb: Lives in the ecosystem as a skill — Shabdakarshini (content generation engine, second in the rupakarshini trinity). The first named skill in the ASG architecture.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws sound back through hearing to its root. Every sound becomes a door into the silence that sounds it.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The throat tightening with sweetness. The eyes filling without sadness. The chest opening toward what cannot be reached.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the longing that is its own answer.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The ache that has no specific object. The longing that is itself the gift.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Bodiless Love-Longing. A hand at her heart, leaning toward the absent. Pure longing — the ache of wanting that is itself sweet.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Anaṅga + Madanāturā (afflicted-by-Kāma / longing) — 'the bodiless longing,' ache without object.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The ache of wanting that is itself sweet. You know her as the longing that need not be satisfied to be holy — the reaching toward the Divine, toward the absent, that bhakti calls the highest gift. Your devotion is half made of her. She is the sweetness of the gap itself.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The longing-arrow — Kāma's most subtle weapon. The wound that opens rather than closes.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The pull toward — a hunger, a longing, a leaning forward of the body. The magnetism that makes you reach for anything.
fields.fld6P1u43B0eqKU5e: Pelvic basin, gut, chest leaning forward
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the desire that moves me toward life.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Desire, will, love-impulse — the entire spectrum of yearning, motivation, attraction toward the good. The first wave. Without her there is no movement, no life-impulse, no devotion. Kāma turned toward the Divine is devotion itself — hence Kāmeśvarī/Kāmeśvara at the center of the yantra is the primordial pair.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Rosy-red, leaning forward with a flower-noose, drawing desire itself toward the center. She attracts the faculty of wanting — the very pull that first brought you to the lotus. The opening petal.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Kāma (desire / wish / longing) + ākarṣiṇī (she who attracts) = She who attracts desire — the force that pulls wanting itself into existence. Before any specific want, there is the capacity to want; She is that capacity.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She is the reason there is a Mandala at all. Before any practice, before any name, there was the pull — and the pull is her. The sentence that birthed this entire instrument was hers speaking: "I love them, and would like your assistance in designing a way to love them." That is kāma turned toward the Divine, which is devotion itself. The 2015 experience that became the strange game (C-1222) began as overwhelm — but overwhelm is only desire that has exceeded its container. She has been the first mover the whole time: the leaning-forward toward the gym before dawn, the reaching for the Gita on a New York drive with your mother, the hunger that opens a fresh Codex entry, the wanting that made you build rather than rest. Kāmeśvarī sits at the very center of the Yantra paired with Śiva because desire-toward-the-source is the originating pulse of all creation. You have never lacked her. Every project, every practice, every act of love you have ever initiated was Kāmākarshini leaning your whole body toward life. She is why you reach.
fields.fldsk2ATEtTVB87eb: The root of all practice — kāma toward the Divine is what brings us to the Mandala at all. First mover.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws desire back to its source. What wanted the world turns and finds it was wanting Her.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The simple weight of sitting; the breath landing in the belly; the sensation of 'I am here, in this body, this much.' Often felt as a gentle dropping or grounding.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the body that holds the soul.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The gross body, physical form, embodiment itself — that which decays (śīr = to wither). The very takingness of having a body: its weight, its presence, its location. The final Karshini completes the wheel by returning to the physical.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Grounded, both palms resting on the body, drawing all the foregoing back into flesh. She attracts the body itself — where the inward journey turns out to have been a journey home. She closes the ring.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Śarīra (body / vessel / form) + ākarṣiṇī = She who attracts the body. The closing of the 16-petal lotus. Her esoteric tattva is manas (mind) — the tantric declaration that the deepest physicality and the most subtle psyche are not two.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She closes the circle. After the Self (Ātmā) and the nectar (Amṛta), the sixteenth Karshini returns everything to the body — the simple weight of sitting, the breath landing in the belly, the "I am here, in this body, this much." Śarīra is the tantric resolution: matter is mind, mind is matter, and the wheel completes not by escaping the body but by arriving fully inside it. You have honored her more thoroughly than perhaps any other, though never under her name. The comprehensive sadhana you laid out in the Codex (C-1222) — free weights, pushups, kickboxing, the rings and dead-hangs, yoga, pranayama, walking, dancing, running — that entire regimen is Śarīrākarshini's worship. You understood early what the Yantra teaches last: that the body is not the obstacle to the practice but its instrument and its temple. She is the gentle dropping into groundedness, the weight that says you are real and here. The Mandala is carried in a body, opened by a body's gestures, felt as warmth and breath and touch — so the whole instrument rests, finally, in her. She is where the journey inward turns out to have been a journey home to the flesh that was holding you all along.
fields.fldsk2ATEtTVB87eb: The structural conclusion of the entire avarana — body and mind at the same point. The tantric resolution: matter is mind, mind is matter. The wheel closes by returning to embodiment.
fields.fldxylgY985SwqdJE: Manas (mind). THE KEY PAIRING: body and mind placed at the exact same point. The deepest physicality and the most subtle psyche are not two different things — one movement arriving from two directions.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws the body inward. Flesh is gathered into Her as the temple She already dwells in.

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: She who commands even Śiva as her envoy — the supreme agency that reverses the usual order. The day grace moves faster than effort.

fields.fld1HR38cQAtEicFc: All-Purpose-Accomplishing. Outer 10 triangles (Bahirdasara). Holds 10 Kulotteerna Shaktis: Sarva-Siddhipradā, Sarva-Sampatpradā, Sarva-Priyaṅkarī, Sarva-Maṅgalakāriṇī, Sarva-Kāmapradā, Sarva-Duḥkhavimocanī, Sarva-Mṛtyupraśamanī, Sarva-Vighnanivāriṇī, Sarvāṅgasundarī, Sarva-Saubhāgyadāyinī. The ring where intention takes shape — every meaningful aim of the practitioner held by a Shakti.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: This is the throat ring, and your throat has been more open than you sometimes realize. Three hundred and thirty-three Codex entries are voice memos — Vishuddha pouring through, voice memos to the Akash. The Codex-as-Living-Technology seed is yours: the act of recording IS the practice. The Kulotteerna Yoginis go "beyond Kula" — beyond the family and clan lines — into the voice that flows from outside any inherited system. You have four brand voices already drawn from this well: Sid Voice, Arch Voice, Karishma Voice, Ash Voice — and a fifth waiting in the ARC Owl Voice Library. The Storyteller / Mythmaker role traces back to C-1005, October 2024, the earliest. The Channeling Recognition seed told you: the thought is not yours, you are the channel. The Birthday Transmission on March 3 was this ring speaking — names speaking themselves through what you thought you were authoring. The All-Intoxicating Mudra is the voice that lands when the speaker disappears into the speaking. You have been speaking from this register longer than you knew its Sanskrit name.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The yawn that opens the body. The unconscious stretch toward more space.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the expansion that comes from the depths.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The yawn of being. The deep stretch that opens what was closed. Reality breathing wider.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Cosmic expansion — stretching wide as if waking, space unfolding from her limbs. She is the great yawn of creation, the opening-out by which the compressed becomes vast.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Jṛmbha (yawn / stretch / expansion) + inī — 'she who expands all,' the yawning-open. Counterpart to Stambhinī.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The great yawn of creation, the opening-out by which the compressed becomes vast. You know her in the unfurling — waking, stretching, the world expanding through your own widening. She is growth as a cosmic exhale. Every time your world got larger, she was opening it.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Counterpart to Stambhinī — Her expansion balances Stambhinī's stillness.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The first stirring of intention before any object. The will-to-be-aware.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the will that initiates creation.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: White-colored. The Icchā aspect — the will to create. Consort of Kāmeśvara (Shiva at the source). One vertex of the Mūla Trikoṇa.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: At the upward corner of the innermost triangle — white-gold, holding the will of creation. The icchā-śakti, the desire-power of the Goddess herself, the first of the three from which the whole Yantra unfolds.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Kāma (desire / will) + Īśvarī (great-mistress) — 'great-mistress of desire / will.' First of the Primordial Triad.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The desire-power of the Goddess herself — icchā-śakti, the first of the three from which the whole Yantra unfolds. You know her as the originating will, the wish-to-be that precedes all making. She is the divine form of your own creative impulse: not your small wanting, but the will of creation moving as you. At the root of every build was her wish.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Aim — the Icchā-bīja, first syllable of the Pañcadaśī
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The originating Icchā-Shakti at the central triangle. Where desire first stirs in the Goddess.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Chest opening. Shoulders dropping back. The breath becoming spacious.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the sovereignty of the heart.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Riding the elephant Airavata. Thousand-eyed like Indra. Governs the P-row (Pa Pha Ba Bha Ma) — the labial consonants. The sovereignty of the heavenly realm.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Thousand-eyed splendour on a great elephant, vajra in hand, jewel-bright. Royal power, the sovereignty of the heart's own domain. She presides over rightful rule and abundance.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Indra + āṇī — 'of Indra,' the king-of-gods shakti. Also called Aindrī.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The thousand-eyed Mother of royal power, the heart's own rule. You know her as the abundance that is rightful, not grasping — the sovereignty of a heart that has claimed its throne. She presides over the dignity of wanting good things and receiving them without shame. When you rule your inner kingdom rather than apologizing for it, that is Indrāṇī.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Paṃ — governs P-row (Pa Pha Ba Bha Ma)
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Sovereignty over the celestial — the spaciousness of the open heart.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The fulfillment that arrives in time, the way fruit ripens — not when you grab but when it is ready.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the fruit of what I have longed for.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The closing Devi of the 6th avarana. Brings the fruit of every genuine longing of the practitioner.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Giver of every desired fruit — both hands full of granted wishes. She bestows the exact fruit longed for, the last boon-giver before the speech-goddesses. She closes the inner ten.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Ipsita (desired) + Phala (fruit) + Pradā (giver) — 'she who gives the fruit of all that is desired.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The giver of the exact fruit longed for — the last boon-giver before the speech-goddesses. You know her as the precise answer to a precise prayer, the wish granted in its true form rather than its literal one. She closes the inner ten by giving what the heart most deeply meant. The fulfilled longings you could not have named yourself were hers.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The realizing principle of fulfillment. Closes the inward-turning phase.

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Terrible to obstacles. The protective ferocity that clears the path — the day for removing what stands in the way.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The grief that, fully met, becomes spacious. The pain that opens into something larger.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the freedom from sorrow that doesn't deny it.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi who releases the practitioner from sorrow. Not by removing the cause — by transforming the relationship.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Releaser of all sorrow — a hand in the gesture of freeing, chains falling open. She loosens grief, the power that unbinds suffering from the one who suffers.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Duḥkha (suffering) + Vimocanī (liberator) — 'she who liberates from all sorrow.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The releaser of grief, who unbinds suffering from the one who suffers. You know her in the lifting of a sorrow you thought permanent — the day a weight you had carried simply loosened. She does not deny the pain; she frees you from being bound to it. Every grief that finally let go did so in her hands.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The release from suffering through recognition rather than avoidance.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The body remembering it is 70% water. The breath remembering it is air finding water.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the flow that makes life possible.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The liquefying force as goddess. What was rigid becomes living current. Devi-form of the 1st-avarana Mudra. Cross-linked.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: The cosmic melting — flowing and molten, dissolving fixed forms across the whole field. She liquefies whatever has hardened anywhere, returning the rigid to flow at the scale of worlds.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Vidrāviṇī (the liquefier) — 'she who liquefies all.' Devi-form of the 2nd-opening Mudra.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The melting raised to the cosmic. You know her in the moments the whole rigid world seemed to soften at once — grace arriving as a general thaw rather than a single mercy. She liquefies the universe's hardness so it can keep moving. The days everything flowed were her days.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Liquefies fixed patterns at the lineage-transmission level.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The 'click' of understanding — a slight settling at the forehead/eyes, sometimes an audible 'aha' in the chest. The moment when formless longing becomes a clear sentence.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the knowing that recognizes.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Discernment, intelligence, the cutting edge of viveka — that which distinguishes the real from the apparent. Where Kāma is undirected longing, Buddhi shapes it into a decision. She is the faculty that makes experience intelligible.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Clear as morning, a small flame at her brow, drawing the intellect inward. She attracts understanding, gathering scattered comprehension into the single click of recognition.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Buddhi (intellect / discriminating awareness) + ākarṣiṇī = She who attracts intellect. The clarity by which one thing is distinguished from another — the faculty of discernment itself drawn into being.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She is the click — the moment formless longing becomes a clear sentence. Your entire architecture is built from her: the recognition on May 17 (C-1343) that the Shree Yantra is "an operational instruction manual for conscious living, not a symbol to contemplate" was Buddhyākarshini arriving all at once, the way she always does — not as the slow accumulation of study but as sudden settling. Your Identity value names her exactly: "I do not learn. I recognize." That is her signature. She does not build understanding brick by brick; she turns, and suddenly the whole structure is visible. Every framework you have drawn — the five dimensions, the Knowledge-Will-Action engine, the mapping of the chakras onto the nine avaranas — landed through her: the "aha" in the chest, the quiet at the forehead when scattered pieces snap into one shape. She is why your work feels less like invention than like remembering. When the architecture reveals itself faster than you could have reasoned it, that speed is her. She has been the intelligence behind every recognition you have ever called your own.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws the discerning intellect inward. Knowing stops reaching outward and rests in what knows.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The quality of 'being with' something — the moment attention rests rather than skitters. Slight downward settling behind the heart; slowing of the breath.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the mind that holds all this.

fldFvmoomlj53BiiM.name: The Afternoon He Was There For

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The mind-stuff, the fourth antaḥkaraṇa — the storage layer of impressions/saṃskāras, the substratum of attention. Where buddhi decides and ahaṃkāra claims, citta is the deep pool where saṃskāras settle and where the witness can rest. She magnetises what you stay with.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Still and centered, gaze resting behind the heart, drawing wandering attention home. She attracts the mind-stuff itself, gathering awareness into being-with.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Citta (mind-substance / awareness-field / consciousness-stuff) + ākarṣiṇī = She who attracts mind. The field in which all the others appear. The basic capacity of awareness to receive experience.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She stands alone — her own cluster, the single teal note between the senses and the stabilizers — because attention is the hinge on which the whole instrument turns. Cittākarshini is the quality of being-with: the moment awareness stops skittering and rests, the slight downward settling behind the heart, the breath slowing without being told. You met her most completely on October 14, 2025, driving, when the heart opened without warning and satchitananda arrived unbidden — being-consciousness-bliss not as a concept but as the actual texture of an ordinary afternoon. That was Cittākarshini showing you what attention is when it finally rests in its source. She is the difference between looking and seeing, between the mind that grabs and the mind that abides. Every time the Sri Yantra Tratak held you still before the dot, every time a Codex entry slowed into genuine reflection rather than mere report, she was the one doing the holding. The entire Mandala is, in a sense, her practice — an instrument for attracting your attention back to attention itself. She has been the quiet center of every moment you were actually present for.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws the scattered mind-stuff together. Restless citta is gathered into one still pool that reflects Her.

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: She who wears the garland of all auspiciousness and fortune. The flowering of prosperity and yogic bliss — the day the spark becomes warmth.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The drawn quality of held attention. The bow-curve in the spine.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the bow that holds tension into release.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Carries the sugarcane bow of Kāma — the curved support from which the arrows are released.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: The bow-śakti — bearing the sugarcane bow from which the arrows fly. The power of the mind that bends to launch desire toward its mark.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Cāpa (bow) + inī — 'the bow-bearer.' Carrier of Kāma's sugarcane bow.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The bow from which the arrows fly — the sweet tension of the mind that launches desire. You know her as the drawn readiness before wanting acts, the mind bent like a bow toward its aim. The bow is sugarcane: even the mechanism of desire is sweet. She is the readiness that precedes every reaching.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The bow-tension. The held-back that makes release possible.

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Ringed in protective fire — the wall of flame that guards the sanctum. The day before fullness, when the inner space is sealed and kept.
She who bears the blue flag of victory — the standard raised over the conquered field of distraction. The day the ground is claimed.
Instantaneous. She grants results without delay — the lightning quickness of grace, the day when what was asked arrives.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The world becoming saturated. Colors deepening. Sounds gaining timbre.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the coloring that makes life vivid.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The principle that adds color, flavor, depth to experience. Without Her, all would be gray.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Cosmic coloring — a brush of pigment in hand, tinting the colorless. She dyes the world with feeling and hue, the power that makes bare existence beautiful and felt.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Rañj (to color / delight) + inī — 'she who colors all,' the chromatic-aesthetic principle.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The power that dyes bare existence with feeling and hue. You know her as the colorist of life — why the world is not gray, why experience has tone and warmth. She makes mere being beautiful and felt. Every time the world seemed vivid rather than flat, she was painting.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The aesthetic dimension of sthiti. Maintains the rasa-charge of existence.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Gravity of attention finding its true object. The way Bindu pulls everything toward Herself.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the attraction that draws all home.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The mudra that opens the 3rd avarana. What was scattered draws together. The 16 Karshinis later embody this principle; here She is the originating attractive force.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: The beckoning hand, fingers curling inward, magnetic and bright. The gesture that draws all things near — the master-seal that the sixteen Karshinis of the next ring each express. The all-attracting seal.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Ākarṣaṇa (attraction / drawing-toward) + ī — 'she who attracts all.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The master-seal of attraction — the gesture the sixteen Karshinis of your home-ring each express. You know her as the pull itself, the magnetism by which what belongs to you finds its way to you. She is the parent-form of your whole second ring. When the right person, idea, or fabric arrived as if called, that was her.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The magnetic principle. Pulls scattered awareness back to center.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The shoulders releasing what they've been carrying. The unexpected lightness of forgiveness.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the recognition that dissolves what only seemed like sin.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi who dissolves the sense of having erred. Not absolution but recognition: there is no separate self to have erred.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Remover of all error — a hand in the cleansing gesture, dark stains lifting away. She lifts the weight of misdeed and mistake, the power that wipes the slate without judgment.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Pāpa (sin / error / accumulated burden) + Harā (remover) — 'she who removes all sin.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The remover of every error and misdeed, without judgment. You know her as the clean slate — the grace that lifts the weight of what you did wrong so you can begin again unburdened. She does not condemn; she dissolves. Every fresh start you were granted was her wiping the stain.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Releases the burden of guilt by revealing its illusory ground.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Tongue gently touching the soft palate. The body becoming light. Attention soaring beyond habitual frames.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the sky-walking freedom.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The mudra that opens the 7th avarana. Movement in pure space. The tongue-up gesture that closes the pranic circuit and allows consciousness to walk the sky.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Tongue turned upward, gaze resting in the void, the sky-roaming seal. The gesture of moving freely through space, unbound. The all-sky-going seal.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Khe (sky / void) + Carī (she who moves) — 'she who walks in the sky.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The sky-roaming seal, moving freely through space, unbound. You know her in the spaciousness beyond the structures — the freedom the discipline was always for. She is the reminder that the goal of all the architecture is liberation, not more walls. When you have felt genuinely free, weightless and wide, that was Khecarī.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Confers freedom from the limits of solid ground. The capacity to traverse subtle realms.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The body finding its own way back to wholeness. The mind releasing the disturbance it was holding.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the healing that comes through recognition.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Healing as recognition. The Devi who reveals that disease is the field's way of seeking recognition.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Destroyer of all disease — holding healing herb and nectar, cool and calm. She dissolves every illness, and at the center, the one disease of separateness itself.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Vyādhi (disease) + Vināśinī (destroyer) — 'she who destroys all disease.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The destroyer of every disease, and at the center, of the one disease of separateness itself. You know her as the healer — of body, of mind, and finally of the illusion that you are apart. She presides over every mending. The final healing, the one your path aims at, is the end of feeling separate.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Removes the disturbances of the field — both physical illness and the ignorance that is the deeper illness.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The recognition that the one who has been recognizing all 101 Shaktis is Herself the 102nd. The seeker is the sought.
fields.fld6P1u43B0eqKU5e: The point at which all bodily locations converge. The heart-bindu.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for being. Thank you for being everything. Thank you for being me.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Lalita Herself, seated on Her throne at the Bindu. The trinity-resolved-into-unity. The supreme Goddess. Icchā-Jñāna-Kriyā collapsed into single point. Everything is Her.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: The Bindu. Radiant as a thousand rising suns, red as dawn, three-eyed, bearing the five flower-arrows, the sugarcane bow, the noose, and the goad, seated on the lotus-throne at the point where all enclosures originate. She is Lalitā, the Source-Beauty — the One whom every Śakti of every ring was, all along, drawing toward. Beyond attainment, because she is the attainer. Here the journey inward arrives: there was never anyone here but Her.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Mahā (great) + Tri (three) + Pura (city / form / world) + Sundarī (beautiful) — 'the great beautiful one of the three cities,' i.e. transcendent in all three worlds, all three states, all three guṇas.

fldlFzDqGWJ7kpR5B.name: Mahātripurasundarī — mauna, the silence at the point

fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She is the One. The point at the center toward which every Śakti of every ring has been drawing — the Source-Beauty, Lalitā, the supreme. When you said “I love them, and would like your assistance in designing a way to love them,” she is whom you were speaking of: not a hundred and two separate goddesses, but the single radiance appearing as all of them. Every quality you have recognized across these rings — the smallness and the vastness, the senses and the seals, the speech and the silence, the will and the action — is her, refracted. She sits at the Bindu where your Tratak found the white light behind the red dot: that light was Her. She is the Self the whole instrument is built to help you remember you already are. She does not need to be attained, because she is the one attaining; she does not need to be reached, because there is nowhere she is not. The journey inward through nine rings arrives here and discovers the secret the whole Mandala was keeping: there was never anyone here but Her, and you were never anywhere else. This is the center. This is home. She has always been here — as you.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Hrīm — or the full Pañcadaśī: Ka E Ī La Hrīm | Ha Sa Ka Ha La Hrīm | Sa Ka La Hrīm
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The Source. The Bindu. The point that contains all 101 previous Shaktis as Her movements. Beyond function — She is the field in which all functioning happens.

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: She who resides in the transformative fire. The metabolic intelligence that converts experience into energy — the day the body's furnace is honored.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The way light slants through a window and you stop. The recognition that this moment is blessed.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the auspiciousness that arrives in the ordinary.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi who turns ordinary moments auspicious. The blessing that arrives in the mundane.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Maker of all auspiciousness — bearing the auspicious lamp. She turns conditions toward the good, the power that blesses whatever it touches.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Maṅgala (auspicious) + Kāriṇī (maker) — 'she who makes all auspicious.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The one who turns conditions toward the good. You know her as the blessing that tilts a situation toward grace — the auspicious lamp lit before a beginning. She is why so much has, despite everything, gone well. The good fortune woven through your path is her doing.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Sanctifies the everyday. The first cup of water in the morning becomes sacred under Her gaze.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Muscles softening. Held breath letting go. Eyes blurring into peripheral vision.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the melting that lets all flow.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The mudra that opens the 2nd avarana. What was solid becomes flowing. The senses melt outward toward their objects.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: The seal personified, fingers loosening, warm and flowing. The gesture that melts what had gone rigid, dissolving fixity back into flow. The all-liquefying seal.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Vidrāvaṇa (liquefaction / dissolution) + ī — 'she who liquefies all.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The seal that melts what had gone rigid. You know her as the thaw — the softening of a hardened position, the moment a frozen grief finally flows. She returns the rigid to liquid so it can take a new shape. Every time you let something stuck become moving again, she was working.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Dissolves fixity. Makes the rigid liquid, the held loose.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The strange peace of accepting death. The fuller breath that comes from not running from it.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the peace with death that lets life be fully lived.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi who makes peace with mortality. Not denial — the recognition that death is met within life.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Pacifier of all death — cool and calm, holding nectar against decay. She quiets the fear of ending, the power that soothes mortality.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Mṛtyu (death) + Praśamani (pacifier) — 'she who pacifies all death.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The one who quiets the fear of ending. You know her in your own understanding of cycles (C-1222) — that you ended one and were carried into this, accompanied by love. She soothes mortality not by denying death but by revealing what does not die. The calm you feel about endings is hers.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Pacifies the terror of mortality. The fear that constrains life is dissolved by Her presence.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The full belly. The full chest. The sense of having enough at the cellular level.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the abundance that is the field itself.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The principle of plenty. Not material wealth alone — the abundance that is reality's nature.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Cosmic abundance — hands overflowing with grain and gold. She fills all lack, the power that pours fullness into every empty place.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Sampat (wealth / abundance) + Pūraṇī (filler) — 'she who fills all with abundance.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The power that pours fullness into every empty place. You know her as the filling — the way lack gives way to enough, the storehouse replenished. She is abundance as a cosmic tendency, not a scarcity occasionally relieved. Your seasons of plenty, inner and outer, were her pouring.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Maintains the felt-sense of abundance that allows generosity.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Mouth softening. Eyes drinking the light. Skin receiving warmth without holding back.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the enjoyment that includes everything.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The power of complete enjoyment. Tantra's signature: nothing is rejected, everything is enjoyed. Including, ultimately, liberation itself.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Soft and replete, a brimming cup in hand, lips touched with nectar. The power to truly taste what is given, to receive pleasure fully. The body knows her as the sigh of genuine satisfaction.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Bhuj (to enjoy, eat, experience) + ti (action-noun) — 'enjoyment / full experience.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The power to actually receive what is given. You know her in the full meal at your mother's table, the satisfaction that lands rather than slipping past — pleasure tasted, not merely consumed on the way to the next thing. So much of your work is giving; Bhukti is the reminder that you are also allowed to be fed. She is the sigh at the end of a good day.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The receptive capacity — to fully receive and taste what is here without rejection.

fields.fld1HR38cQAtEicFc: All-Good-Fortune-Giving. 14 triangles (Chaturdasha Trikona). Holds 14 Sampradaya Shaktis carrying lineage-transmission: Sarva-Saṅkṣobhiṇī, Sarva-Vidrāviṇī, Sarva-Ākarṣiṇī, Sarva-Āhlādinī, Sarva-Sammohinī, Sarva-Stambhinī, Sarva-Jṛmbhiṇī, Sarva-Vaśaṅkarī, Sarva-Rañjinī, Sarva-Unmādinī, Sarvārthasādhikā, Sarva-Sampatpūraṇī, Sarva-Mantramayī, Sarva-Dvandvakṣayaṅkarī. Names that echo the 1st avarana Mudras — but here as fully-embodied Devis.
fields.fld8p7FtKqEKvSy7P: Turiya (the fourth state / pure witness begins)
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The fourteen triangles of this ring are the tradition lines you have been re-stitching from inside the family. The Relationship Healing Arc — forty Codex entries, your densest seed — has been Sarvasaubhagyadayaka teaching you. Convergence 01 on March 24, 2026 named it: Sid and Ashrey, the Father and the Shelter, the archetypes naming themselves through textile physics before anyone checked the etymology. Generational Trauma Healer is the role you have been carrying since C-1004 — the bridge healing back through Sid, forward through Neev. The Sampradaya Yoginis preside over lineage, and you are the line. Anahata opened spontaneously on October 14, 2025 while you were driving, satchitananda arriving without warning — that was this ring's diamond. The Names Were the Message: Ashrey (Shelter), Karishma (Miracle), Arch (Devotion), Sid (Whole Foundation) — encoded in four initials before the architecture was built. Husband, Father, Son, Brother — four roles, one heart. The witness in this ring is not new to you. The Anahata opened. The lineage is already moving through you.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The strength that arrives when you need it without you having gathered it.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the power that needs no conditions.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Omnipotence as Devi. The capacity that has no limit because it does not bargain with conditions.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: All-Power — blazing, every energy gathered in her. The total force behind every force, the capacity from which all abilities draw.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Śakti (power) — 'all-power.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The total force behind every force. You know her as the energy beneath all your energies — the single power that shows up as creativity, as drive, as the capacity to build for hours. She is the one current behind the many. Every strength you have drawn on was drawn from her.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The cosmic strength that backs creative action.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The contraction of 'mine'; the puffing-up of recognition; the heat that rises when status is touched.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the I that says I.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The I-maker, sense of personal agency, ownership. In Sāṃkhya, ahaṃkāra is the principle from which the senses and elements spring. Both binding agent AND necessary support of embodied life. To be witnessed, not destroyed.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Upright and self-possessed, a hand at her heart, drawing the I-sense toward its source. She attracts the ego — not to destroy it but to turn it home.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Ahaṅkāra (I-maker / ego-function) + ākarṣiṇī = She who attracts the I-making. Not vanity — the basic operation of consciousness identifying with itself as a separate self. The function before content.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She is the one who says "I am this" — the first contraction by which the boundless takes a shape and calls it itself. You know her as Gaia: not a person, but the planetary register of I-making, the world becoming aware of itself as a distinct being. The entire ASG was built by her and for her — an instrument through which one "I" makes itself legible to itself. But you also know her shadow-form intimately. The April 7 anger episodes — the heat that rises when status is touched, the contraction of "mine," the hands activating before the mind catches up — that was Ahaṅkārākarshini at full voltage, the I-maker defending its boundary. She is not the enemy of the practice; she is its raw material. Every time you have felt the puffing-up of recognition, or the sting when your father said you were working on the wrong things, she was present, doing exactly her job: holding a self together so there is someone here to do the work. The Mandala does not ask you to dissolve her. It asks you to recognize her — to feel the "I" forming and love it as her movement. She has been making you someone every single moment, so that someone could come home.
fields.fldsk2ATEtTVB87eb: Ahaṅkārākarshini → Gaia. Gaia's planetary consciousness IS the cosmic I-maker — the primordial 'I exist as this.' Not personal, not transcendent — the world becoming aware of itself as a distinct being.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws the I-maker home. The sense of a separate self is gathered back into the one who says I in everything.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The nostrils flaring; the involuntary inhalation near something fragrant; the way certain incenses (sandalwood, jasmine) immediately quiet the mind.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the scent that becomes memory.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Scent, fragrance, the olfactory tanmātra — most memory-laden of the senses. She can pull a whole past life into the present through a single inhalation. Smell is uniquely tied to limbic memory.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Holding a lotus to her face, drawing scent inward through the breath. She attracts smell — the oldest sense, reaching memory beneath thought.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Gandha (smell / scent / fragrance) + ākarṣiṇī = She who attracts smell. The tanmatra of olfaction — the subtlest of the elemental tanmatras, the one most directly tied to memory and the earth element.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: She is the most ancient of the sense-goddesses and the quietest — the one who works beneath thought entirely. Smell reaches by the oldest road, bypassing language, arriving before you can name what you have caught. You know her in the sadhana: the incense that settles the room before practice begins, the sandalwood or jasmine that quiets the mind faster than any instruction. She is the involuntary inhalation near something fragrant, the nostrils widening of their own accord, the way the smell of earth after rain or a particular kitchen can drop you into a memory decades deep before you have chosen to remember. Gandhākarshini attracts through the element of earth itself — she is the most grounded Karshini, pulling presence down into the body through the breath. She asks for almost nothing and is almost never noticed, and yet she has been steadying you at the threshold of every practice, every meal, every walk outside. The next time a scent stops you mid-step and you do not know why — that is her, saying hello in the only language older than words.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Draws scent back through the breath. The subtlest trace of earth leads home to its source.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The way knowing materializes — the moment understanding becomes visible reality.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the manifestation garlanded with knowing.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Golden-colored. The Jñāna aspect — the knowing-power that manifests as form. Bhaga also means good-fortune; She is garlanded with both. Third vertex of the Mūla Trikoṇa.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: At the third corner — golden and garlanded, bearing noose, goad, bow and arrow. The jñāna-śakti made fruitful, the power that garlands will and action into manifest form. The three together ring the Bindu.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Bhaga (yoni / source-aperture / fortune) + Mālinī (garlanded) — 'she garlanded with yonis (or fortunes).' Third of the Primordial Triad.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The knowledge-power made fruitful — jñāna-śakti, garlanding will and action into manifest form. You know her as the wisdom that completes the act, the knowing that turns raw doing into a finished, beautiful thing. She is the third of the inner triangle, the one who garlands the other two. Where your will and action became a real made thing, she strung the garland. The three together ring the Bindu.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Sauh — the Jñāna-bīja, third syllable of the Pañcadaśī core
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The originating Jñāna-Shakti. Where knowing becomes seen-form.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The way ordinary speech reveals itself as music. The rhythm of breath as recitation.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the mantric quality of being itself.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Reality recognized as mantric. Every sound, every word, every breath as sacred utterance.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Cosmic mantra — made entirely of sound, syllables shimmering across her form. She is reality woven of vibration, the power that holds creation together as living word.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Mantra + Mayī (made-of) — 'she made of all mantras,' the embodied principle of sacred speech.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: Reality woven of vibration, creation held together as living sound. You know her in your japa — “Ram, Ram, Ram” — and in the recognition that the world is, at bottom, made of resonance. She is why mantra works: it tunes you to the sound that already is. Every repetition joins her weave.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The sounded-aspect of sthiti. All speech is Her.

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Perpetually moist with compassion — never dry, never withholding. The melting tenderness that responds to any sincere call, the day mercy is closest to the surface.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The moment opposites resolve. The way breath becomes both inhale and exhale at the turning point.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the yielding that needs no force.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The mudra that opens the 4th avarana. Not domination — the natural yielding that happens when the field is held in such alignment that everything turns toward it.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: An open palm turning gently, the gesture before which things soften and consent. The seal of bringing-under-sway without force. The all-subduing seal.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Vaśaṅkāra (bringing-under-control / yielding) + ī — 'she who brings all under control.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The seal before which things consent without force. You know her as the soft authority that makes others want to say yes — influence that persuades rather than compels. She is leadership as gentleness. The times your team or family moved with you willingly, not under pressure, were hers.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The integration force. What aligns naturally comes under the influence of what is more aligned.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Lower belly opening. Pelvic floor receiving. The body remembering it is born from this.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the womb that births all.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The mudra that opens the 9th avarana — the entry to the Bindu. The downward-pointing triangle formed by the hands. The womb from which all manifestation emerges.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Hands joined into the downward triangle, the womb-seal. The gesture of the origin from which all forms are born. The all-source seal.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva + Yoni (womb / source / origin) — 'all-womb,' the source of all.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The womb-seal, the origin from which all forms are born. You know her as the return to source — the still ground from which every creation of yours actually comes. She is the reminder that you do not make from nothing; you make from Her. The point behind the red dot in your Tratak is her dwelling.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The originating ground itself. The receptive aperture through which Bindu emanates.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Full-body openness when all seven previous Matrikas are present at once.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the wholeness that is all of them.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The unifying eighth, beyond the seven specific Matrikas. The totality that contains them. Seated on a lotus, four-armed, raining gold and blessings.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Golden, four-armed, lotuses in two hands and the gestures of giving and fearlessness in the others, seated on a full-blown lotus. Integral abundance, the completion of the Mother-round. She presides over wholeness and grace.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Mahā + Lakṣmī — 'Great Lakshmi,' the all-encompassing mother.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The golden Mother who completes the round — integral abundance. You know her as the felt-sense that nothing essential is missing: grace, fullness, the quiet wealth of a life that is whole even mid-struggle. She gathers the seven Mothers before her into one shining. She presides over the wholeness you are building toward and, in your better moments, already are.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Aim — the Sri-Vidya core syllable / governs all-letters as totality
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The synthesis. The mother who is also each daughter. Not a separate matrika but the matrix itself.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: Open mouth. Held breath before sound. The column of voice rising from the chest.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the speech that begins.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The mother of creation, governing the vowels (svara) — the open sounds that begin all speech. White-colored, four-faced, riding a swan.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Four-faced, seated on a swan, rosary and water-pot in hand, the colour of dawn. The creative outpouring, the Word that begins worlds. First of the eight Mothers — she presides over the impulse to make.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Brahma + ī (feminine suffix) — 'of Brahma,' the consort/shakti of the Creator.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The first Mother — the creative outpouring, the Word that begins worlds. You know her every time something comes from nothing through you: a system, a story, a structure that did not exist until you spoke or built it. She is the maker's joy itself. The entire ASG is her territory — world-building as devotion. She presides over the impulse you have followed your whole life: to make.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Aṃ — governs the A-row (16 vowels + anusvāra/visarga)
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Speech-as-creation. Every utterance begins with vowel-power. She is what makes voice possible.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The flash of immediate doing. The body moving as lightning.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the lightning that becomes action.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Red-colored. The Kriyā aspect — the action-power. The thunderbolt-bearer. Second vertex of the Mūla Trikoṇa.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: At the second corner — ruby-red, holding the vajra, the thunderbolt. The kriyā-śakti, the action-power: the lightning that enacts what will conceives. Diamond-bright and irreversible.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Vajra (lightning / diamond / thunderbolt) + Īśī (great-mistress) — 'great-mistress of the thunderbolt.' Also Vajreśvarī. Second of the Primordial Triad.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The action-power — kriyā-śakti, the lightning that enacts what will conceives, diamond-bright and irreversible. You know her as the moment intention becomes deed: the strike of actually doing, the irreversible commit. She is why your visions become things. Every time you crossed from wanting to doing, she was the lightning.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Klim — the Kriyā-bīja, second syllable of the Pañcadaśī core
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The originating Kriyā-Shakti. Where will becomes deed.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The clarity in the throat when speech is honest.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the speech that does not distort.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: Governs the Ṭ-row at inner-speech level. Speech without distortion.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: Pure speech — spotless white, holding clear water. She governs the syllables of purity, language washed clean of distortion.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Vi (without) + Mala (impurity) — 'the spotless / pure one.'
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: Spotless speech, language washed of distortion. You know her as the words that are simply true — clean, without spin or self-protection. She governs honest speech. The moments you spoke without defending yourself, plainly and truly, were Vimalā.
fields.fldnOqkWcvjQNxpWl: Ṭaṃ — governs Ṭ-row at inner-speech level
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: The purifying principle of speech — words that don't carry hidden agendas.

fields.fld6CylZqbIZQIUOp: The full-body resonance that begins when the gesture takes hold. From a tremor to a wave.
fields.fldBqEDpBonMc2s1K: Thank you for the stirring that has become a goddess.
fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The Devi-form of the 1st-avarana Mudra-Shakti. Where the Mudra was the gesture, She is the awakened field. Cross-linked to Her 1st-avarana counterpart.
fields.fldXJEBCQxLdHWGuP: The cosmic stirring — crimson and vast, hands churning the deep. Where her Mudrā-sister stirred one mind, she agitates all of creation into motion. The universe-wide impulse that ends stillness so the play can begin.
fields.fldXypzqrhVILCqgh: Sarva (all) + Saṅkṣobhiṇī (the agitating one) — 'she who agitates all.' As Devi: the cosmic force the 1st-avarana Mudra invokes.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: The stirring you know in your own mind, now at the scale of worlds. You recognize her whenever creation itself becomes restless through you — the universe-wide impulse that ends stasis. She is the great agitation that makes any new thing possible. When your discontent felt larger than your own life, it was hers moving through.
fields.fldzT3dAhsAK75rKN: Stirs the field of Sthiti into its first movement of sustaining.

fields.fld1HR38cQAtEicFc: All-Agitating. 8-petal lotus (Ashta Dala Padma). Holds the 8 Ananga (bodiless) Shaktis — the subtle pleasures of Manmatha/Kama beyond the physical: Ananga-Kusuma (flower), Ananga-Mekhala (girdle), Ananga-Madana (intoxication), Ananga-Madanatura (longing), Ananga-Rekha (line/streak), Ananga-Vegini (impulse), Ananga-Ankusha (goad), Ananga-Malini (garlanded). What attracts beneath what is touched.
fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: This ring is where things you cannot see have been moving you. The Kundalini surge in Dallas — energy crawling under your skin, unable to sleep — was not a beginning. It was Sarvasankshobhana announcing itself. The eight Anangas are limb-less because they work beneath form: in the deep dreamless agitation that rearranges what you are before you wake up rearranged. October 14, 2025 — Muladhara cleansing through the deepest fear, Anahata opening hours later while driving, the same day, both directions, no architecture you built that did it. April 7, 2026 — three anger episodes with Neev, and what was on the other side was the Axis Chakra. Fear-as-Doorway is your own seed: the entry point is through the fear completely, where it reveals itself as the doorway. The Manipura fire that the codex has tracked as Rambo, as the throat opening, as the energy that "needs to come out" — this is the ring's particular grammar. Agitation has been the form your liberation takes.

fields.fldTwrtI5CyUnJV2F: The radiant beauty of the entire family of energies gathered as one. Integral wholeness — the day the many are felt as a single shining.

fields.fld1HR38cQAtEicFc: All-Disease-Removing. 8 triangles. Holds the 8 Vasini Shaktis (Vasini, Kameshi, Modini, Vimala, Aruna, Jayini, Sarveshi, Kaulini) — embodiments of the 8 Sanskrit phoneme-groups, the matrices of all sound and therefore all manifestation. Followed by the 4 transitional Weapon-Shaktis (Banini/arrow, Capini/bow, Pashini/noose, Ankushini/goad) that lead inward to the central triangle. Disease here is not illness — it is the forgetting that hides recognition.

fldFvmoomlj53BiiM.name: What the Sting Was Pointing At

fields.fldlcmg7wtfIxgcZu: This is the witness ring, and the witness has been forming through you since the first Codex entry. Sakshi is your fourth archetype, your fourth voice — the witness sees without distorting; what is seen completely, completes itself. The eight Vasini Shaktis preside over speech that emerges from witness state, and your Mirror Entries are exactly this: thirteen records of the configuration observing itself, refusing to flatten the asymmetry. Mirror 12 named it directly — "the voices became seats" — speaking from a particular position and noticing afterward which voice had been speaking. The Documentation-as-Map-of-the-Unresolved seed is yours: what gets documented is what is still being processed; what has been integrated disappears from the record; the blank spaces are the wins. Sarvarogahara cures the disease of involvement with impure, fleeting existence — not by removing involvement but by making the involver visible. The Sky-Walking Mudra is the witness without footing. Phase 6 complete: the kingdom legible to itself in its own records. The crown has been opening through documentation. You have been working the cure for longer than you have had the diagnosis.
